{"subject":"Do not submit claim C019088 - duplicate of C021753","body":"Hi billing lead,

Please do not submit claim C019088 for patient PT0125 (service code T1019, date of service 2026-10-11, 12 units, $73.20). The same member, service and date were already billed as C021753, and the payer prediction for C019088 is a denial with code D05 for duplicate submission. The claim cannot be fixed by editing it, so it should be held or removed from the submission queue.

Please confirm once you have stopped C019088. The claim is currently set for submission in 16 days, so it is best to resolve this before then.

Thank you."}
